business_summary: Daoming Optics&Chemical Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of various functional films and polymer synthetic materials in China and internationally. The company offers personal protection solutions, including normal reflective fabric, reflective leather and yarn, finished, reflective clothing, heat transfer film, prismatic reflective tape, flame retardant, industrial washable, elastic reflective fabric, photoluminescent, and fancy fabric products. It also provides vehicle safety solutions, such as vehicle retro-reflective markings and finished products; and road safety solutions comprising reflective films for permanent and temporary road signs, reflective films for special purposes, license plate films, and finished and accessory products, as well as advanced materials solutions consisting of laser etched films, release materials, and decorative films. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Yongkang, China.
